profile_text.body:
XPENG INC. is a public company headquartered in Guangzhou, traded under the ticker XPEV and registered with the SEC under CIK 0001810997. Its Spanish market site presents a fully electric range under the slogan "Xpande tu mundo," and the company says it has been turning into reality what the world calls the future since 2014.

The site describes three models, the G6, G9 and P7⁺, which it says combine artificial intelligence and advanced driver assistance systems with the SEPA 2.0 800-volt electric platform. According to the company, that platform allows charging from 10% to 80% in 12 minutes across the range. All three models carry the DGT CERO label and a warranty of up to 7 years / 160,000 km.

The site also lists financing offers for the G6 RWD Standard Range and the G9 RWD Standard Range, with cash prices of 41.122,71€ and 56.590,30€ respectively, and states that financing is offered subject to review and approval by Open Bank, S.A. It names CAETANO AUTOMOTIVE ESPAÑA DISTRIBUCIÓN, S.L.U. as the party responsible for handling data submitted through the site. No lawsuits involving the company are noted.
